Why a message was refused.

A message that cannot be read is a refusal, never a partial answer: every name here is something the writer did that the specification does not allow, and every one of them carries the offset it happened at, because a byte stream has no line numbers to point at.

A wire value the format does not define: a reserved string encoding, a chunk size of zero, a boolean that is neither.
